# secureaccess_application_exception_lists (Data Source)

This data source reads the ids of the exception application lists that the Do Not Decrypt lists of the organization use. A Do Not Decrypt list that has applications uses one, the API returns its id as `exceptionapplicationlistId` of that Do Not Decrypt list. Use the `secureaccess_application_exception_list` data source to read a list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secureaccess_application_exception_lists" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the exception application lists that Do Not Decrypt lists use.
